note: Manual test cases drafted by Devin. Xray is not installed on this Jira, so these keys are the ones used in the specs' `xray` annotation; when Xray is available, create them as Test issues linked to the story and replace the keys.

tests.summary: Transfer of exactly the daily limit is accepted
tests.precondition: Persona daily.limit exists. Its Everyday Current Account holds more than its daily limit (seed: balance 1500, limit 1000) and it has a second account (eSaver, balance 250) to receive the money
steps: Choose Everyday Current Account as From and eSaver as To
Enter an amount equal to the daily limit (1000) and a reference
tests.expected: Success message 'Transfer of £1,000.00 sent. New balance £500.00.' is shown with no error, and Accounts shows Everyday Current Account at £500.00 and eSaver at £1,250.00

tests.summary: Transfer of one pound over the daily limit is rejected with 'Daily limit is <limit>'
tests.precondition: Persona daily.limit exists. Its Everyday Current Account holds more than the daily limit plus one pound (seed: balance 1500, limit 1000), so the rejection is caused by the limit and not by insufficient funds
steps: Choose Everyday Current Account as From and eSaver as To
Enter an amount one pound over the daily limit (1001)
tests.expected: Error 'Daily limit is 1000' is shown with no success message, and Accounts still shows £1,500.00 and £250.00
